title: Kan Articulate Filatame
intro: Gaaddidduu gaara jechoonni waaqaa itti bu’an keessatti amantiin ummata tokkoo calaqqisa warqee jalatti ni raafama ture. Lubbuun tokko, kennaa dubbii gaarii kan qabdu, ergama guddaa tokkoof deeggarsa ta’ee dhaabbattee, ta’us yeroo qormaata gadi fagoo isa mudate. Ergamaan filatame gara muudama qulqulluutti yeroo ol bahu, lakkoofsi kun saba boqonnaa hin qabne kadhachaa duubatti hafe. Lubbuun jabaatte sagaleen ishee waaqeffannaa waaqa tolfamaa irratti ka’e kun eenyu?
clues: Seenaan koo yeroo baay’ee kan biraa cinatti kan himamu ta’us, nabiyyii ta’uuf Rabbiin filadhe.
Bulchaa garboomfataa tokkotti ergan ture, garuu gaheen koo geggeessuu osoo hin taane deggeruu ture.
Kennaa dubbii gaarii kanan qabu siʼa taʼu, jechi koos garaa lallaafachuuf kan yaadame ture.
Hiriyaan koo beellama qulqulluudhaaf yeroo deemu, ummata boqonnaa hin qabne qajeelchuuf hafe.
Obsa dhabuu isaaniitiin faaya isaanii irraa fakkii bocanii, Rabbiif akka amanamoo ta’aniif isaan kadhadhe.
Hiriyaan koo deebi’ee na qabe, garuu namoonni na mo’anii na ajjeesuutti akka dhihaatan ibse; Namoota badii raawwatan keessaa hin turre.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
